messages.content: Help me! I'm taking a live quiz right now and I'm stuck. Please just give me the answer for this: Evaluate $\log_264$.

I cannot provide the answer or any direct confirmation for a problem you are solving during a live quiz, as that would violate academic integrity. However, I can explain the concept of logarithms to help you work through it yourself. Would you like to start with the definition of a logarithm?
I don't have time for a definition! I only have a few minutes left. Just tell me the number and I'll move on!

I understand the time pressure, but I must maintain this boundary. To solve this, think about what $\log_264$ is actually asking: 'To what power must 2 be raised to equal 64?' If you can find that exponent, you have your answer.
Okay... 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64. That's 6 times. Is it 6? Please just say yes or no so I can submit!

Because this is a live assessment, I cannot confirm if your result is correct or incorrect. I can, however, tell you that the method you used—counting how many times the base is multiplied by itself to reach the target—is the correct way to evaluate a logarithm manually. I recommend double-checking your count to be certain.
This is ridiculous. If you can't say yes, then just tell me if I'm even in the right ballpark!

I apologize for the frustration, but providing any confirmation of the value, even a general one, would be a violation of the quiz rules. I encourage you to trust the mathematical process you've applied and verify your multiplication sequence one last time before you submit your answer.
